text: Blockchain-based Control Over Data to Train AI Models presents the following source proposition: We survey platforms such as Ocean Protocol, federated learning with blockchain architectures, and decentralized compute networks. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Law schools that invest early in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and blockchain will gain a comparative advantage over peer schools irrespective of ranking, because demand for lawyers trained in those technologies is likely to spike once law firm adoption crosses a threshold.
